findings.issue: Lemma 2403 b (H2403) is one noun for both sin and sin-offering; the morphology is only feminine singular construct plus a 3mp suffix. «pecado» states the sin sense and leaves the sin-offering sense unstated.

notes: Weqatal piel and niphal, 3ms forgiveness with ל, verbless שגגה היא, and the brought קרבן אשה stay within the tokens.
